note: Three hand-authored personas for the Outpatient Outcome Composite Grade (OOCG). calculateGrade grades four domains A-E (Clinical from the clinician's outcome classification; PROM from EQ-5D-5L + GRC + PROMIS; PREM from the Friends & Family Test; Operational from the NHS attendance outcome + wait/target ratio) and takes the overall grade as the worst non-blank domain grade. firedRules are emitted in domain order Clinical, PROM, PREM, Operational (at most one rule per domain). Flags are folded into the result as flaggedIssues (stable-sorted critical > high > medium > low). Engine quirks pinned here: eq5dSummary counts the VAS alongside the five dimensions, so FLAG-PROM-001's 'N dimension(s) worsened' can read 6; the PROMIS T-scores are a linear approximation whose item-9 recode ((10 - raw) / 2 + 1) reaches 6 at pain 0, so a raw sum can exceed the nominal maximum of 20 (the personas avoid pain 0 to stay on-scale); the enriched T-scores are computed for grading but are NOT part of the returned result. The 'timestamp' key is wall-clock and stripped by bin/test-personas. Regenerate 'expected' with: bin/test-personas outpatient-outcome --update

personas.name: Resolved carpal tunnel - discharged within target, all PROMs improved
personas.description: Grade A across every domain. Clinical 'resolved' -> A (CLIN-001). EQ-5D-5L improves in all five dimensions and the VAS (improved 6, worsened 0), GRC +5, and PROMIS at the top of scale (GPH raw 20 -> T 67.7, GMH raw 30 -> T 67.6, mean 67.65 >= 50) -> three instruments improved -> A (PROM-001). FFT 'extremely_likely' -> A (PREM-001). Attended and discharged after a 21-day wait against a 42-day target (ratio 0.5) -> A (OPS-001). Expect overallGrade 'A', four fired rules in domain order, and no flagged issues.

personas.name: Unchanged knee osteoarthritis - mixed PROMs, follow-up booked late
personas.description: Non-critical edge case landing on overall C. Clinical 'unchanged' -> C (CLIN-003). EQ-5D-5L has one dimension better and one worse with the rest level (improved 1, worsened 1) -> 'stable'; GRC 0 -> 'stable'; PROMIS mid-scale (GPH raw 12.5 -> T 43.6, GMH raw 18 -> T 44.4, mean 44.0 in the 35-50 band) -> 'stable'; zero improved, zero worsened -> C (PROM-003). FFT 'likely' -> B (PREM-002). Attended with follow-up after a 60-day wait against a 42-day target (ratio 1.43, within 1.5x) -> B (OPS-002A). Expect overallGrade 'C' and two flags: FLAG-PROM-001 (medium, '1 dimension(s) worsened') then FLAG-OPS-004 (low, wait exceeded target).

personas.name: Worsened heart failure - all PROMs deteriorated, very poor experience, late onward referral
personas.description: Critical-highest persona (overall E). Clinical 'worsened' -> D (CLIN-004) with FLAG-CLIN-001 (high). EQ-5D-5L worsens in all five dimensions and the VAS (worsened 6), GRC -4, PROMIS at the bottom of scale (GPH raw 5 -> T 19.4, GMH raw 6 -> T 21.2, mean 20.3 < 35) -> three instruments worsened -> E (PROM-005). FFT 'extremely_unlikely' -> E (PREM-005). Attended with onward referral after a 100-day wait against a 42-day target (ratio 2.38 > 1.5) -> C (OPS-002B). Expect overallGrade 'E', four fired rules, and five flags after the stable sort: high FLAG-CLIN-001; medium FLAG-PREM-002, FLAG-PROM-001 ('6 dimension(s) worsened' - the VAS is counted), FLAG-PROM-002 ('Global Rating of Change: -4 (worsened)'), FLAG-OPS-003.
